integrity: The all-order theorem is proved by a deterministic open-run counting identity plus discrete convexity. Exact finite computations are checks, not the infinite proof. Independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independently retained undirected edges on a homogeneous path, uniform post-vaccination seed, and exactly one perfectly vaccinated vertex; the threshold is an absolute case count. Does not assert priority in inaccessible literature or applicability to correlated contact-based SIR models.
title: Sharp divergence between mean-outbreak and threshold-risk vaccination on paths
